ashley_csm: FYI we just heard from Fjord's analytics — theyare spinning up three BI squads and want a single-provider solution for embeddings + live meeting summaries. They called out big month-end ETL spikes. cc @maria_cs
maria_cs: Good signal. Do we have numbers? If ramp intersects renewal window this is prime expansion/negotiation timing.
ashley_csm: PM gave rough peaks: 180-220k embed ops/day; summary workload ~40-60k tokens/day. Theyexpect short high-qps bursts (~10x baseline) during their daily batch windows.
luis_engineer: Helpful. Need avg token lengths, whether clients batch embeddings, and index update cadence (real-time vs nightly). Batch vs streaming changes cache and shard strategy.
zoe_onboarding: We should offer a 90min multi-squad enablement: ingest playbook (S3 -> Redwood), quick eval harness for summaries, and embedding-runbook. Two slot options next week: Wed 11am PT or Fri 2pm PT.
maria_cs: Also confirm success metrics: is it strict latency (95p <250ms for similarity) or correctness of summaries for dashboards? Both change model/config and contract asks.
tony_se: If they want 95p <250ms during spikes, Dedicated is the right call with prefix/KV caching + optimized kernel selection. Hosted PoC feasible for functional validation but must call out SLO variance.
sarah_revops: Ashley, what's their renewal date? If renewal <=6 months we should align contract cadence and propose SLA add-on in advance.
ashley_csm: Renewal sits about 4.5 months out. PM open to SLA upgrade if we can commit to latency targets.
luis_engineer: One technical question: do similarity lookups require sliding-window semantics (time-decay) or point-in-time static indices? Sliding-window reduces cache hits and increases write load.
ashley_csm: PM says similarity index is mostly append-only but with nightly compaction; meeting summaries are streaming.
zoe_onboarding: I'll draft a tailored onboarding checklist and a repo demo that includes an ingest pipeline, embedding refresh script, and a summary stream simulator.
maria_cs: Also catalog compliance asks early: finance squad flagged PII — they may need Private (VPC/on-prem). We'll need to map KMS/HSM, retention, and audit log expectations.
tony_se: If Private is required for one squad, timeline shifts; we should surface migration costs and a cutover plan. I'll prepare a quick capacity + cost delta sheet (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
ashley_csm: Requested payload samples and a QPS histogram from their infra team. Asked them to include token lengths and simultaneous session counts for summaries. ETA EOD.
redwood-bot: Reminder: create a Gainsight play and tag as expansion signal. :robot_face: 
ashley_csm: Created the Gainsight play and labeled revenue stage: expansion. Assigned internal owner for follow-up. @sarah_revops please own renewal negotiations.
sarah_revops: On it. I'll schedule a contract review 6 weeks out and loop Legal for a possible data addendum/NDA extension for finance.
zoe_onboarding: Blocking: confirm attendee list and final slot for the enablement workshop. Also ask PM whether they want function-calling outputs (structured JSON) for dashboard ingestion.
luis_engineer: Blocking: their infra team must give us the QPS histogram and a short sample of embedding payloads (redacted). Also we need their expected index update frequency.
maria_cs: Any other blockers? If they need structured outputs we need to validate model choices and prompt templates in the PoC.
ashley_csm: Will consolidate answers and post here when I receive them. If anyone has specific ask to surface to the PM (cost guardrails, SLA options, migration windows), drop it here.
tony_se: Add to ask: their target RTO for degraded modes (if we fall back to smaller model or higher latency). That defines acceptable fallback policies.
ashley_csm: Good point. I'll add that question. Next update EOD in this thread. :white_check_mark:
